messages:
emma_sales: quick heads-up 11 FinSafe wants a brief technical POC. Requirements: EU-only data residency, BYO KMS, tenant pinning so traffic never leaves EU. Also asked for a definitive list of subprocessors (they want no US-based processing). Need scope, rough cost uplift, and timeline.

oscar_se: Clarifying q: are they OK with Hosted + EU pinning, or insist on Dedicated/Private? Also is control-plane EU-only required or just data-plane?

emma_sales: Hosted preferred but buyer is nervous. Ideally control-plane EU-only too, but they said data-path is the hard constraint. They want subprocessor list before legal signs SOW.

liam_eng_ops: Feasibility: we can do EU-only data residency but tradeoffs:
- Hosted + tenant pin: routes data to an EU region (e.g., eu-west-1). Control plane might still touch global infra unless we attach a private control-plane.
- Dedicated/Private: full EU control-plane and no cross-border backups if configured. Better for strict no-US subprocessors.

Ops config snippet:
region_pin: eu-west-1
fallback_policy: "eu-only"
allowed_subprocessors: ["aws-eu-west-1", "azure-northeurope", "datadog-eu", "sentry-eu"]

Notes: Some telemetry vendors support EU-only endpoints but need opt-in. BYO-KMS: supported via KMS proxy/HSM integration; adds ~1-2 weeks for key setup and attestation.

liam_eng_ops: Cost estimates (very rough): Hosted w/ EU pinning + subproc whitelist: ~+15-25% on hosted unit price due to reserved pool and routing overhead. Dedicated: one-time provisioning cost + monthly reserved price depending on GPU sizing; need QPS and token volumes to firm numbers.

jana_product: POC proposal: 45-60 day sandbox in eu-west-1, BYO-KMS staging flow (stub keys), tenant pinning, runbook + success criteria. I can draft a POC SOW template and checklist. Will flag legal items.

security_bot: Security checklist: DPA + subprocessors appendix, KMS attestation docs, network diagram with egress paths, SOC2 report, pen-test summary. If client insists on zero-US subprocessors, we must validate each vendor's EU-only processing mode and document it.

emma_sales: Action items: 1) I'll confirm with FinSafe whether Hosted w/ EU-only control-plane is acceptable or they need Private. 2) @liam_eng_ops draft ops handoff, precise subprocessors list (CSV), and two pricing scenarios (Hosted EU-pin vs Dedicated) by EOD. 3) @jana_product prep POC SOW template and list legal pre-reqs.

liam_eng_ops: On it. Will include runbook, subprocessors CSV (region + endpoint + contact), and pricing delta w/ assumptions. ETA ~6 hours.

emma_sales: Thanks all. I'll update FinSafe after convo. :thumbsup:
